baseline.public_hook_shape: useRaceSocket(speed?: string | null) with a shared singleton, one owner, and argument-free subscribers; useRaceSnapshot({ source, replayId, speed }) owned its own replay WebSocket in addition to polling.
baseline.baseline_tests: tests/unit/test_race_socket.ts baseline characterization added, covering connected frame, URL builders, race_snapshot, race_update predictions, and normalizeRow anti-slop checks.

red_tests: Added tests/unit/test_race_socket.ts tests for connected frame parsing with model_version, snapshot drivers map, event_count, and normalizeRow without fake math.
Initial run failed as expected on missing modelVersion and drivers contract, establishing the missing behavior before implementation.

implementation.socket_hook: useRaceSocket accepts RaceSocketOptions { source, replayId, speed } while retaining the legacy positional owner-speed call and argument-free subscribers. A legacy speed-only owner is treated as replay without an id and therefore remains disconnected rather than being misrouted to live. One singleton connection, owner lifecycle, visibility resume, and exponential reconnect behavior remain centralized.
implementation.protocol: raceSocketProtocol.ts parses connected, race_snapshot, and race_update at the boundary, requires replay_id in replay mode, sends source=live for live mode, and exposes q10/q50/q90/tyre_deg/pit_next_3, eventCount, drivers map, and source_timestamp/observed_at/received_at/source_id/provenance/data_age_seconds/stale.
implementation.truthfulness: Only backend provenance/source marks data LIVE; stale input marks STALE. Event rows require backend source_id and event_type, use backend received_at/source timestamps, and do not synthesize IDs, event text, lap/flag telemetry, or timestamps. Initial lap availability is explicitly false and flag is UNKNOWN. Missing predictions/freshness are null. normalizeRow in useRaceSnapshot does not invent gap or tyre age values.
implementation.snapshot_polling: Removed the duplicate WebSocket from useRaceSnapshot.ts, retained its HTTP snapshot/catalog polling, propagated snapshot freshness metadata, and removed Date.now-style fallback timestamps and synthetic (index * 1.5) gaps.
